description: A labelled text input (DESIGN.md, TextField): label sits above the field; hint or error goes under it. The box turns to the accent when focused, to TsuyaColors.danger with an error. Built on EditableText: its own selection handles (accent teardrops) and its own context menu (Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all), except on iOS where the system context menu is used. Use TextField.search for a search field (a pill with no visible label).

params.name: label
params.description: Above the field, or only announced for a search field.

params.name: controller
params.description: Uncontrolled when null (the field keeps its own).

params.name: focusNode
params.description: A node the field keeps when none is given.

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Shown in TsuyaColors.textMuted while the field is empty; never read by a screen reader.

params.name: hint
params.description: Under the field, replaced by error.

params.name: error
params.description: Under the field instead of hint, with the alert glyph; also marks the field invalid in semantics.

params.name: optional
params.description: Appends the optional marker to label.

params.name: required
params.description: Marks the field as required in semantics.

params.name: leading
params.description: Before the text, in TsuyaColors.textMuted.

params.name: trailing
params.description: After the text, after any clear or reveal button.

params.name: clearable
params.description: Shows a clear button (from the labels) while the field holds text.

params.name: obscureText
params.description: Hides the text, one line only.

params.name: revealable
params.description: With obscureText, shows a show/hide button (from the labels).

params.name: enabled
params.description: Disables the field: faded, read-only, not focusable.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses the field as soon as it is built.

params.name: maxLines
params.description: At least twice TsuyaSize.controlMd tall and scrolling once reached, when more than 1 (or null).

params.name: minLines
params.description: The fewest lines the field reserves room for.

params.name: keyboardType
params.description: The on-screen keyboard to show.

params.name: textInputAction
params.description: The action its submit key performs.

params.name: autofillHints
params.description: Autofill group hints (email, password…).

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called on every change.

params.name: onSubmitted
params.description: Called when the field is submitted.

params.name: contextMenuBuilder
params.description: Replaces the field's own context menu; `null` keeps it (the system one on iOS where supported).

constructors.name: search
constructors.description: A search field (DESIGN.md, Search): a pill with a leading search glyph, a clear button by default, and no visible label (label is still required, used for semantics). glass uses control glass over content.
